title: Spectacular · adj.
subtitle: 「壯觀／驚艷／令人震撼／引人注目」，究竟是哪一種 spectacular？
description: 「壯觀／驚艷／令人震撼／引人注目」，究竟是哪一種 spectacular？

words.meaning: 令人印象深刻的；出色的
words.note: 使用者提供。impressive 是 spectacular 最核心、最廣泛的近義詞之一，表示某事因規模、品質、成就或效果而令人佩服。它比 spectacular 少一點視覺震撼，適用範圍更廣。
words.example: The team delivered an impressive performance under pressure.

exercises.original: The research team produced a spectacular set of results despite limited funding.
exercises.zh: 研究團隊在資金有限的情況下取得了令人印象深刻的成果。
exercises.upgrade: impressive · 令人印象深刻的；出色的

options.explanation: results + achievement under constraints points to admiration for quality rather than visual drama.
強調醒目、鮮明、對比強或特徵突出。 本題的決定性線索是 an achievement deserving admiration；這裡需要的是「因成就／品質而令人佩服」。因此 striking 雖與 spectacular 有重疊，但是否強調成就、自然美景、視覺對比、宏偉氣勢、戲劇性變化或耀眼效果並不最吻合。
強烈而較口語，表示外觀、表現或轉變極為驚艷。 本題的決定性線索是 an achievement deserving admiration；這裡需要的是「因成就／品質而令人佩服」。因此 stunning 雖與 spectacular 有重疊，但是否強調成就、自然美景、視覺對比、宏偉氣勢、戲劇性變化或耀眼效果並不最吻合。

words.meaning: 令人屏息的；美得令人驚嘆的
words.note: 使用者提供。breathtaking 常形容景色、自然景觀、建築或視覺場面，強調美麗或宏偉到令人一時屏息。它比 impressive 更強烈，也更偏視覺／感官反應。
words.example: The view from the summit was breathtaking.

exercises.original: The spectacular view across the valley stopped us in our tracks.
exercises.zh: 山谷景色令人屏息，令我們不由自主停下腳步。
exercises.upgrade: breathtaking · 令人屏息的；美得令人驚嘆的

words.meaning: 引人注目的；鮮明的；醒目的
words.note: 使用者提供。striking 強調某物因外觀、對比、設計或特徵鮮明而立即吸引注意。它不一定像 spectacular 那麼宏大，但更著重 salience and distinctiveness。
words.example: The building has a striking geometric façade.

exercises.original: The exhibition's most spectacular feature was a red sculpture in the centre of the white room.

exercises.upgrade: striking · 引人注目的；鮮明的；醒目的

words.meaning: 耀眼的；令人目眩神迷的；極精彩的
words.note: dazzling 強調亮度、華麗、技巧或精彩程度高到令人目不暇給。它特別適合 lights, displays, jewellery, costumes, technical skill, performance。比 spectacular 更偏 brilliance and brilliance-like impact。
words.example: The dancers wore dazzling costumes covered in tiny mirrors.

falseSynonyms.zh: impressive 更廣，可形容能力、成果或規模；spectacular 通常更強烈、更有視覺／戲劇效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The results were impressive. The fireworks were spectacular.

falseSynonyms.zh: breathtaking 特別偏美景／場面美到令人屏息；spectacular 可用於商業成績、表演或巨大變化。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The mountain view was breathtaking. The company achieved spectacular growth.

falseSynonyms.zh: striking 強調醒目、鮮明、對比強；spectacular 通常更宏大、更強烈。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She wore a striking coat. The fireworks were spectacular.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者都很強；stunning 較口語、可形容轉變／外觀／表演，spectacular 更常帶場面或規模感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The redesign was stunning. The opening ceremony was spectacular.

falseSynonyms.zh: magnificent 強調 grandeur/splendour；spectacular 強調視覺或戲劇效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The palace was magnificent. The fireworks were spectacular.

falseSynonyms.zh: dramatic 可以只是變化幅度大或效果強烈，不一定好看或值得讚賞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was a dramatic fall in prices. The show was spectacular.

falseSynonyms.zh: dazzling 特別適合光線、服裝、珠寶、技巧等耀眼／精彩效果；spectacular 更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The dancers wore dazzling costumes. The entire production was spectacular.

falseSynonyms.zh: spectacular 是形容詞；spectacle 是名詞，表示壯觀場面／景象。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The display was spectacular. The display was an extraordinary spectacle.
